title: Craftable Uncraftable Items/Blocks (CUIB)
description: In this Datapack, you can craft items that are usually uncraftable. The current items/blocks are; Saplings, Mushrooms, Fungi, Dragon Head, Dragon Egg, Netherite Upgrade, Stone Ores, Deepslate Ores, Nether Ores, and a Trident, More coming soon!
body:
# In this Datapack, uncraftable items now get recipes! The current recipes are:
## Saplings:
- Oak Sapling
- Birch Sapling
- Spruce Sapling
- Acacia Sapling
- Cherry Sapling
- Pale Oak Sapling
- Dark Oak Sapling
- Mangrove Propagule
- Jungle Saplings
## Mushrooms:
- Red Mushroom
- Brown Mushroom
## Fungi:
- Warped Fungus
- Crimson Fungus
## Ores:
### Stone Ores:
- Coal Ore
- Copper Ore
- Iron Ore
- Gold Ore
- Redstone Ore
- Lapis Ore
- Emerald Ore
- Diamond Ore
### Deepslate Ores:
- Deepslate Coal Ore
- Deepslate Copper Ore
- Deepslate Iron Ore
- Deepslate Gold Ore
- Deepslate Redstone Ore
- Deepslate Lapis Ore
- Deepslate Emerald Ore
- Deepslate Diamond Ore
### Nether Ores:
- Nether Quartz Ore
- Nether Gold Ore
- Ancient Debris
## Other:
- Dragon Head
- Dragon Egg
- Trident
- Netherite Upgrade Template
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
